data.transcript:
Conversations - Fashion & Shopping Practices

​1. For Customer (Clothing, Shoes, Hats & Accessories)

​Good morning! I am looking for a casual denim jacket and a white T-shirt.

​Excuse me, do you have this dress available in a size medium or large?

​Where can I find the fitting rooms or dressing rooms to try these on?

​Could you please bring me a larger size for these jeans? They feel a bit tight.

​Does this shirt come in any other colors, like navy blue or olive green?

​Where is the footwear section for running shoes and formal leather shoes?

​I would like to try on these sneakers in a size forty-two, please.

​Are these high heels comfortable for walking long distances?

​Could you measure my foot size to make sure I am getting the right fit?

​Do you have any wide-fit options available for these leather boots?

​Excuse me, where can I find winter hats, caps, and beanies?

​I am looking for a wide-brim sun hat for my upcoming beach vacation.

​Does this baseball cap have an adjustable strap at the back?

​What material is this coat made of? Is it real leather or synthetic?

​Are there any active sales, discounts, or promotions on winter apparel today?

​Is this winter jacket waterproof and suitable for heavy cold weather?

​Could you tell me the return and exchange policy for clothing items?

​If this size does not fit me well, can I bring it back to exchange within seven days?

​Can I leave these selected items at the checkout counter while I continue browsing?

​Do you accept credit card payments, or is there an extra tax for digital payment?

​2. Sales Assistant & Shop Staff

​Welcome to our store! Please feel free to let me know if you need any assistance.

​Are you looking for anything specific today, or are you just browsing?

​All our summer collection clothing is currently twenty percent off today!

​The fitting rooms are located right down the hallway on your left.

​Let me check our stockroom to see if we have your size available.

​Here is the large size you requested. How does it fit you now?

​That outfit looks absolutely fantastic on you! The color suits you really well.

​These leather shoes are made of genuine calfskin leather and are very durable.

​Would you like me to hold these items at the front cash register for you?

​We have a buy-one-get-one-fifty-percent-off promotion on all hats and caps today.

​This baseball cap is one-size-fits-all with an adjustable back buckle.

​You can return or exchange any item within fourteen days with the original receipt.

​Please make sure to keep the price tag attached if you plan to exchange it later.

​We accept all major credit cards, mobile wallet apps, and cash payments.

​Here is your receipt and your shopping bag. Thank you for shopping with us!

​3. Dialogues

​DIALOGUE 1: BUYING CLOTHING & TRYING ON SIZES

​Sales Assistant: "Hello! Welcome to Trend Fashion. How can I help you today?"

​Customer: "Hi, good afternoon! I really like this casual flannel shirt. Do you have it in a size large?"

​Sales Assistant: "Let me check the rack for you... Here is a size large in red plaid, and we also have it in dark green."

​Customer: "Great! Where are the fitting rooms? I would like to try both of them on."

​Sales Assistant: "The fitting rooms are right over there past the denim section. You can take up to four items inside."

​(After trying on the clothes)

​Customer: "The green one fits perfectly, but the sleeves on the red one are a bit too long."

​Sales Assistant: "The green flannel shirt looks really sharp on you! Would you like to get that one today?"

​Customer: "Yes, I will take the green one. Is it machine washable?"

​Sales Assistant: "Yes, it is one hundred percent cotton and machine washable. Let me take it to the cash register for you."

​DIALOGUE 2: SHOPPING FOR SHOES & HATS

​Customer: "Excuse me, I would like to try on these black leather sneakers on display."

​Sales Assistant: "Of course! What shoe size do you normally wear?"

​Customer: "I usually wear size forty-two or forty-three depending on the brand."

​Sales Assistant: "Let me grab both size forty-two and forty-three from the stockroom so you can see which feels more comfortable."

​(Customer tries on the sneakers)

​Customer: "Size forty-two feels a bit snug around the toes, but size forty-three fits comfortably with socks."

​Sales Assistant: "Forty-three looks like the right fit with enough room for your toes. Are you looking for any matching caps or hats today as well?"

​Customer: "Actually, yes! I am looking for a simple black baseball cap."

​Sales Assistant: "We have our new arrival adjustable cotton caps right here near the mirror. They go great with those sneakers."

​Customer: "Oh, this black cap is perfect! I will take both the sneakers and the cap."

​Sales Assistant: "Excellent choices! That will be eighty-five dollars in total. You can pay right here at the counter."

data.title: Bài 127: Các cuộc trò chuyện - Những phương thức canh tác tại nông trại cây ăn quả
data.transcript:
Conversations - Fruit Orchard Practices

​1. For Visitor & Customer

​Good morning! Is the fruit orchard open for self-picking today?

​Where can I collect a ladder, shears, and a picking bucket?

​Which specific rows or sections of the orchard are open for harvesting today?

​Are these fruit trees grown organically without chemical pesticides?

​How do I know if an orange or peach is fully ripe and ready to be picked?

​Should I twist the stem gently or use fruit clippers to harvest from the tree?

​Is there an admission fee, or do we only pay for the weight of the fruit we pick?

​How much is the price per kilogram for fresh apples and citrus fruits?

​Are we allowed to taste a sample fruit while picking in the orchard?

​Do you offer fresh fruit juices, jams, or dried fruit preserves at your farm stand?

​Are these dwarf fruit trees or full-sized traditional orchard trees?

​Can we buy young fruit tree saplings or grafted branches to plant in our home garden?

​How many acres does this fruit orchard cover, and how many trees do you have?

​Is there a shaded picnic area where we can sit and enjoy our fresh fruits?

​What is the best month of the year to visit for peak harvest season?

​2. Orchardist & Fruit Farmer

​Welcome to our fruit orchard! Please be careful when stepping between the tree rows.

​Please use the provided fruit clippers and cut the stem cleanly near the fruit.

​Do not pull or yank the branches hard, as it can damage next year's fruit buds.

​The sweetest and most mature fruits are located on the outer edges receiving full sunlight.

​Please only pick what you intend to buy, and avoid dropping ripe fruit on the ground.

​We use drip irrigation lines and organic mulch under each tree to conserve soil moisture.

​Over in section B, we grow several sweet varieties of peaches, plums, and nectarines.

​We prune our fruit trees every winter to control their height and ensure maximum fruit quality.

​You can taste one sample fruit per person while picking in the orchard.

​When your basket is full, please bring it to the weighing table near the orchard entrance.

​All our fresh fruit preserves and cold-pressed fruit juices are sold at the wooden barn shop.

​Please watch out for honeybees around the fruit blossoms and fallen fruit.

​We use natural netting over the canopy to protect our ripening crop from birds and hail.

​We charge five dollars per kilogram for hand-picked fresh produce.

​Thank you for visiting our orchard today! Enjoy your sweet and fresh harvest!

​3. Dialogues

​DIALOGUE: HARVESTING FRESH FRUIT IN THE ORCHARD

​Visitor: "Good morning! We are excited to pick some fresh fruit today. Which trees are ready for picking?"

​Orchardist: "Good morning! Welcome! Rows one through five in the citrus section are loaded with sweet, ripe oranges and tangerines."

​Visitor: "That sounds great! How can we tell if an orange is completely ripe before picking it?"

​Orchardist: "Look for firm fruits with a deep, uniform orange color. Give it a gentle squeeze; if it yields slightly and smells fragrant, it's ready!"

​Visitor: "Should we pull them directly off the branch with our hands?"

​Orchardist: "It's best to use these small pruning shears. Cut the stem about half an centimeter above the fruit so you don't tear the skin."

​Visitor: "Got it. Cut cleanly at the stem. Is there a price difference between the tangerines and the oranges?"

​Orchardist: "They are both four dollars per kilogram. You can mix them together in the same basket."

​Visitor: "Perfect! Where do we head after we finish filling our baskets?"

​Orchardist: "Just bring your baskets back to the front shed. We will weigh them, pack them in sturdy boxes, and give you a complimentary bottle of our fresh fruit juice!"

data.title: Bài 128: Các cuộc trò chuyện - Những phương thức tại trang trại chăn nuôi lợn
data.transcript:
Conversations - Pig Farm Practices

​1. For Visitor & Customer

​Good morning! Are public visitors allowed to tour the pig farm facilities today?

​What strict biosecurity protocols and disinfection steps must we follow before entering?

​Where should we change into protective overalls and sanitized rubber boots?

​Are the pigs raised in outdoor pasture enclosures or inside climate-controlled barns?

​What type of feed diet do you give to the pigs, and is it locally sourced?

​How old are the piglets when they are weaned from the breeding sows?

​Could you show us the automated feeding and drinking systems used in the pens?

​How do you manage waste disposal and odor control across the swine barns?

​Do you operate a biogas system to convert pig manure into renewable energy?

​Are the pigs routinely vaccinated to prevent common livestock diseases?

​What is the average weight of a market-ready pig before transport?

​Are visitors permitted to enter the farrowing house to see newborn piglets?

​How many breeding sows and market pigs do you maintain on this farm?

​What measures do you take to ensure animal welfare and stress-free handling?

​Where can we purchase farm-fresh pork or organic pork products directly?

​2. Swine Farmer & Livestock Specialist

​Welcome to our pig farm! Please step through the boot disinfection bath first.

​All visitors must wear clean disposable suits and sanitized footwear on-site.

​Please do not enter any enclosed barn without direct permission from farm staff.

​We maintain high biosecurity standards to keep our herd healthy and disease-free.

​Our farm uses fully automated climate control to regulate temperature and ventilation.

​The sows are kept in comfortable farrowing pens equipped with heat lamps for newborn piglets.

​We feed our herd a balanced mix of corn, soybean meal, minerals, and vitamins.

​Fresh water is provided continuously through automatic nipple drinkers in each pen.

​Our manure management system collects waste into a underground biogas digester.

​We closely monitor the growth rates and health metrics of each pig group daily.

​Newborn piglets receive special care and nutrition during their first few weeks.

​Market pigs are transferred to spacious finishing pens until they reach full size.

​All our animals are vaccinated according to national veterinary guidelines.

​We practice strict sanitation and wash down the pens between every production batch.

​Thank you for observing our biosecurity guidelines during your visit today!

​3. Dialogues

​DIALOGUE: LEARNING ABOUT PIG FARMING & BIOSECURITY

​Visitor: "Good morning! We are here for the scheduled educational tour of your pig farm."

​Farmer: "Good morning and welcome! Before we proceed, we need to complete our biosecurity intake."

​Visitor: "Of course! What steps do we need to take before going near the barns?"

​Farmer: "Please step into the boot wash station to sanitize your shoes, then put on these disposable suits and boot covers."

​Visitor: "Got it. Why are the biosecurity measures so strict here?"

​Farmer: "It protects our herd from airborne viruses and external bacteria that visitors might unknowingly carry on their clothes or shoes."

​Visitor: "That makes total sense. How are the pigs housed inside the farm?"

​Farmer: "We have separate specialized areas: the breeding barn, the farrowing unit for mothers and piglets, and the finishing pens for growing pigs."

​Visitor: "How do you keep the barns clean and odor-free with so many animals?"

​Farmer: "We have slatted concrete floors that allow waste to drop into an automated flushing system beneath the pens, which feeds straight into our biogas generator."

​Visitor: "That is a very efficient and eco-friendly setup! Can we see the piglet section from behind the viewing glass?"

​Farmer: "Yes, absolutely. Follow me down this hallway to the observation gallery."

data.title: Bài 129: Các cuộc trao đổi - Quy trình tại nhà máy chế biến hải sản
data.transcript:
Conversations - Seafood Processing Plant Practices

​1. For Quality Inspector & Client

​Good morning! I am here to perform a quality and hygiene audit on the seafood processing line.

​What temperature is maintained inside the cold storage rooms and processing rooms?

​Could you please demonstrate your sanitary wash procedures before entering the clean zone?

​Are all batches of raw shrimp, squid, fish, and crab inspected for freshness upon arrival?

​How do you test for chemical residues, antibiotics, or heavy metals in raw seafood materials?

​What is the current freezing method used for shrimp and fish fillets: IQF or block freezing?

​Could you show me the metal detection and X-ray inspection equipment on the packing line?

​How do you maintain the cold chain from raw material receiving to final container loading?

​Are all workers wearing full sanitary gear, including hairnets, masks, gloves, and apron sets?

​What method do you use to de-vein, peel, and size-grade fresh shrimp?

​How is crab meat extracted and pasteurized to ensure food safety and long shelf life?

​What is the moisture and glazing percentage applied to frozen squid rings and fish fillets?

​Are all master cartons labeled with full traceability information, lot numbers, and production dates?

​Where are the Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) logs and temperature tracking charts kept?

​What is the daily processing capacity for frozen seafood products at this plant?

​2. Plant Supervisor & Quality Control Officer

​Welcome to our seafood processing facility! Please step through the air shower and boot wash station.

​All personnel must wash and sanitize their hands for at least twenty seconds before entering.

​We enforce strict temperature controls; the processing room is kept below twelve degrees Celsius.

​Raw shrimp are sorted, size-graded, and head-off processed according to strict customer specifications.

​Our squid processing line handles gutting, skinning, tube cleaning, and ring slicing under iced conditions.

​Whole fish are scaled, gutted, filleted, and pin-boned using high-precision stainless steel machinery.

​Crab processing requires immediate steam boiling followed by rapid ice chilling to preserve meat texture.

​Every batch undergoes strict microbial testing and sensory evaluation before export clearance.

​We use Individually Quick Frozen (IQF) technology to freeze seafood at minus forty degrees Celsius.

​Ice flakes are continuously added to raw material totes to keep core temperatures near zero degrees.

​All equipment and conveyor belts undergo chemical sanitation between every operational shift.

​Waste materials like fish scales, crab shells, and shrimp heads are redirected to feed processing plants.

​Our plant holds international food safety certifications, including HACCP, BRC, and ISO 22000.

​Here are the latest inspection reports and temperature records for your review.

​Please ensure all product packaging is vacuum-sealed without any air leakage before boxing.

​3. Dialogues

​DIALOGUE: INSPECTING SEAFOOD PROCESSING & QUALITY CONTROL

​Inspector: "Good morning! We are conducting a routine inspection of your shrimp and squid processing lines today."

​Supervisor: "Good morning! Welcome. Please put on these sanitized boots, hairnets, and protective coats before entering."

​Inspector: "Thank you. What is the intake temperature of the raw shrimp batch received this morning?"

​Supervisor: "All raw shrimp arrived packed in slurry ice at two degrees Celsius. We tested the core temperature immediately upon unloading."

​Inspector: "Excellent. How do you handle size-grading and quality sorting on the line?"

​Supervisor: "Shrimp pass through automated weight-grading machines, then our trained workers perform manual checks for shell damage or discoloration."

​Inspector: "I see. What about the squid processing line over there?"

​Supervisor: "Squid are gutted, skinned, and washed with chilled purified water. They are then sliced into rings or prepared as whole tubes based on customer orders."

​Inspector: "How long does it take for products to go from raw preparation to the IQF freezer?"

​Supervisor: "Less than thirty minutes. Keeping processing times short is essential to maintaining premium texture and peak freshness."

​Inspector: "Great! May I examine your metal detector calibration logs and freezer temperature records?"

​Supervisor: "Certainly! Right this way to the Quality Assurance office. All digital logs are updated hourly."

data.title: Bài 130: Các cuộc trao đổi - Những thông lệ tại nhà máy sản xuất máy móc
data.transcript:
Conversations - Machinery Manufacturing Plant Practices

​1. For Engineer, Technician & Operator

​Good morning! I am inspecting the precision CNC milling machine before starting the shift.

​Could you please review the CAD models and technical blueprints for this gearbox casing?

​We need to calibrate the hydraulic press to maintain a tolerance within 0.02 millimeters.

​The digital readout on the lathe machine is showing a sensor measurement discrepancy.

​Please check the coolant liquid levels and lubrication pressure before running heavy cuts.

​We need to adjust the spindle speed and feed rate for cutting stainless steel components.

​The laser cutting machine requires a lens cleaning and beam realignment this morning.

​Is the raw forged steel batch accompanied by the material test certificate?

​We should perform a non-destructive testing (NDT) scan on the structural welds.

​Could you hand me the torque wrench and the digital vernier caliper from the toolbox?

​The automatic tool changer on unit four jammed during the tool swapping sequence.

​We need to replace the carbide cutting inserts because the cutting edges are worn down.

​Please ensure all safety interlocks and light curtains are fully operational.

​Where are the assembly instructions and bill of materials (BOM) for this pump engine?

​We need to align the drive shaft and motor coupling using the laser alignment tool.

​2. Plant Manager, Maintenance Supervisor & QC Lead

​Welcome to the heavy machinery fabrication shop! Safety gear is mandatory beyond this point.

​Please make sure to wear your high-visibility vest, safety glasses, and ear protection.

​We are scheduling a preventive maintenance overhaul for the main gantry crane this weekend.

​Quality control rejected three machined shafts due to surface roughness exceeding limits.

​We need to optimize the assembly line cycle time to hit our target output of fifty units per week.

​Has the dynamic balancing test been completed for the high-speed turbine rotors?

​Please log all machine downtime and mechanical fault causes into the maintenance portal.

​We must strictly comply with ISO manufacturing standards and industrial safety codes.

​Ensure that all hydraulic oil leaks are immediately contained and reported to maintenance.

​We are conducting a vibration analysis test on the main motor bearings this afternoon.

​Please re-torque all structural bolts on the frame according to the engineering manual.

​The casting components are ready for final finish grinding and powder coating.

​Make sure all electrical cabinets are securely closed and rated for IP65 environment.

​We are holding a toolbox safety meeting on overhead crane operations at eight AM.

​Great work on completing the custom industrial gearbox assembly ahead of schedule!

​3. Dialogues

​DIALOGUE: CNC MACHINING & QUALITY INSPECTION

​Engineer: "Good morning! Are we ready to begin machining the main drive housing for project B?"

​Machinist: "Good morning! The raw aluminum block is clamped on the 5-axis CNC machine, but I wanted to verify the datum points first."

​Engineer: "Good catch. Let's zero the touch probe against the reference surface according to the zero-point fixture drawing."

​Machinist: "Understood. What cutting parameters should we set for the roughing pass?"

​Engineer: "Keep the spindle at 8,000 RPM with a feed rate of 1,200 millimeters per minute. Make sure the flood coolant is turned on high."

​Machinist: "Got it. I'll run a dry simulation on the controller first to check for any potential tool collision."

​(After running the machining cycle)

​Machinist: "The roughing pass is completed. I'll take a measurement of the inner bore diameter now."

​Engineer: "Use the bore gauge to measure at three different depths to check for any taper or out-of-roundness."

​Machinist: "The measurement is 85.01 millimeters, which is right in the middle of our target tolerance range!"

​Engineer: "Excellent work. You can proceed with the finishing toolpath and chamfering."

data.title: Bài 131: Các cuộc trao đổi - Thực tiễn xây dựng nhà ở (Kiến trúc sư & Nhà thầu)
data.transcript:
Conversations - Residential Construction Practices (Architect & Builder)

​1. For Architect & Structural Designer

​Good morning! Let's review the architectural floor plans and elevation drawings for the new family house.

​Please make sure the ceiling height in the living room is maintained at exactly 3.2 meters.

​We need to verify the column and beam layouts to ensure they align cleanly with the partition walls.

​Could you please check the staircase riser and tread dimensions to ensure they comply with safety standards?

​Where should we position the drainage pipe penetrations through the foundation footing beams?

​Please ensure the roof slope and gutter placement are designed for proper rainwater runoff.

​We need to specify the waterproofing details for the second-floor balcony and bathroom wet areas.

​Could you check if the window and door openings match the exact dimensions on the shop drawings?

​Make sure the electrical socket and lighting switch heights are marked clearly on the interior walls.

​We need to review the septic tank location and drainage slope with the plumbing contractor.

​Could you provide a detailed drawing for the custom-built timber staircase railing?

​Please verify that the exterior wall insulation and paint finish match the client's approved color scheme.

​We need to coordinate the air conditioning refrigerant pipe routes before plastering the interior brickwork.

​Let's check the boundary setbacks and building height limits to ensure full regulatory compliance.

​Great job on the foundation layout; we are ready to proceed with the ground floor slab construction.

​2. Builder, Mason & Site Foreman

​Good morning, architect! We have finished excavating the trench footings for the foundation.

​Should we pour a lean concrete layer at the bottom of the trench before laying the rebar cages?

​The masonry team is currently building the foundation retaining walls using concrete blocks and mortar.

​How many courses of bricks should we lay before inserting the horizontal steel reinforcement ties?

​Could you please clarify the door swing direction for the main entrance and bedroom doors?

​We need more bags of cement and washed sand for laying the ground floor tiles tomorrow.

​The scaffolding around the second-floor balcony is securely erected and ready for plastering.

​Should we install the electrical conduit pipes inside the brick walls before or after plastering?

​We noticed a slight conflict between the plumbing pipe path and the window lintel beam.

​How long should we keep the timber shoring props supporting the second-floor concrete slab?

​We are applying a waterproof coating to the bathroom floor slab before installing the ceramic tiles.

​The exterior wall plastering is complete, and we are ready to apply the primer and finish paint.

​Could you confirm the tile pattern and grouting color selected for the kitchen backsplash?

​We have finished clearing the construction debris and cleaning up the site for the client handover.

​Everything is built strictly according to the architectural blueprints and your site instructions.

​3. Dialogues

​DIALOGUE: RESIDENTIAL SITE INSPECTION & WALL LAYOUT

​Architect: "Good morning! I came by to check the masonry work on the ground floor walls."

​Builder: "Good morning, architect! We have finished setting up the brick walls for the kitchen and living room."

​Architect: "Let's check the doorway opening for the kitchen... The width looks like 90 centimeters on site, but the plan specifies 1 meter."

​Builder: "Ah, let me check my tape measure and the floor plan... You're right. We left extra space for the door frame, but we need to trim 10 centimeters."

​Architect: "Yes, please adjust that partition brick column before the plastering team arrives tomorrow."

​Builder: "Understood. We will fix that right away. How about the window height in the living room?"

​Architect: "The sill height is good at 90 centimeters from the finished floor level. That will give a great view of the front yard."

​Builder: "Glad to hear that. We also ran the electrical conduits for the TV and air conditioner sockets as you requested."

​Architect: "Excellent. Make sure you take progress photos of the conduit layout inside the walls before we cover them with mortar."

​Builder: "Will do, architect! We will finish the adjustments today and send you the update."

data.title: Bài 132: Các cuộc trao đổi - Những quy tắc thực hành tại công trường xây dựng đường bộ
data.transcript:
Conversations - Road Construction Site Practices

​1. For Highway Engineer & Site Manager

​Good morning! Let's review the road alignment and cross-section drawings before starting today's earthworks.

​Please check the subgrade compaction test results using the sand cone method before we lay the aggregate base course.

​We need to verify the road slope and crown elevation to ensure proper surface water drainage.

​Could you confirm the asphalt mix design temperature before the paving crew begins laying the asphalt concrete?

​Make sure the concrete curb and gutter slipform machine is set precisely along the stringline.

​We need to conduct a dynamic cone penetrometer (DCP) test on the soil subgrade in section three.

​Please ensure all traffic management signs, safety cones, and temporary barricades are deployed in the work zone.

​Have you inspected the installation of the reinforced concrete box culverts for cross-drainage?

​We need to test the bitumen emulsion tack coat spraying rate before laying the wearing course.

​Please check the road shoulder compaction and side ditch elevation to prevent water ponding.

​Make sure the road rollers maintain the correct pass count and vibration frequency during compaction.

​We need to conduct core sampling on the asphalt layer to measure the compacted thickness and air voids.

​Please ensure the geo-grid reinforcement layer is stretched taut over the soft clay subgrade.

​How is the progress on constructing the retaining wall alongside the mountain slope section?

​All thermoplastic road markings and cat-eye reflectors must be applied strictly to technical standards.

​2. Paving Foreman, Surveyor & Equipment Operator

​Good morning, engineer! The land surveying crew has set the grade stakes and centerline offsets for section two.

​The motor grader is currently shaping and leveling the aggregate base course layer to the specified grade.

​Should we increase the moisture content of the base material before using the pneumatic tire roller?

​The hot-mix asphalt trucks are arriving at the site; the asphalt delivery temperature is 150 degrees Celsius.

​We need to adjust the asphalt paver screed width and thickness controls to match the road design profile.

​The steel drum roller is following closely behind the paver for initial breakdown rolling.

​We encountered a soft subgrade patch near station 2+500 that requires undercut and gravel replacement.

​Could you confirm the slope gradient for the roadside drainage channel and embankment slopes?

​We are setting up the automated total station to monitor the final pavement surface smoothness.

​How many passes of the heavy vibratory roller are required to achieve ninety-eight percent compaction?

​The concrete crew is pouring the reinforced concrete retaining wall for the bridge approach road today.

​We need to clear the dust and loose particles off the binder course before applying the tack coat layer.

​The lane closure and flagger control setup are fully compliant with highway traffic safety rules.

​We have completed the prime coat application on the crushed stone base and are waiting for it to cure.

​Everything is built according to the highway engineering blueprints and your site instructions.

​3. Dialogues

​DIALOGUE: ASPHALT PAVING & SUBGRADE INSPECTION

​Engineer: "Good morning! I am here to inspect the base course prep and oversee the asphalt paving on section four."

​Foreman: "Good morning, engineer! We finished compacting the crushed stone base course this morning and ran the density tests."

​Engineer: "Great. Did the field compaction test meet the required ninety-eight percent maximum dry density?"

​Foreman: "Yes, the sand cone test result came back at ninety-eight point five percent, and the surface tolerance is within five millimeters."

​Engineer: "Excellent. What is the temperature of the asphalt mix in the delivery trucks arriving from the batching plant?"

​Foreman: "I tested the first three trucks with the infrared thermometer. The mix temperature is hovering around 155 degrees Celsius, which is well within the acceptable range."

​Engineer: "Good. Make sure the distributor truck applies the tack coat evenly across the surface before the paver starts."

​Foreman: "Understood. The tack coat is being sprayed now at zero point four liters per square meter."

​Engineer: "Perfect. Keep the steel drum roller right behind the paver for breakdown rolling while the mix is above 130 degrees."

​Foreman: "Will do, engineer! We will monitor the temperatures continuously and maintain the rolling pattern strictly."

data.title: Bài 133: Các cuộc hội thoại - Thuê nhà & Dịch vụ tiện ích
data.transcript:
Conversations - House Rental & Utility Services

​1. For Tenant & Customer

​Good morning! I saw your advertisement for the apartment for rent and would like to schedule a viewing.

​How much is the monthly rent, and does it include any utility bills or management fees?

​How much is the security deposit required, and what are the lease agreement terms?

​Could you please clarify how the electricity and clean water bills are calculated every month?

​Is there a individual electric meter and water meter installed specifically for this rental unit?

​What is the price per kilowatt-hour for electricity and per cubic meter for clean water?

​Are there any additional service fees for trash collection, building maintenance, or motorbike parking?

​Excuse me, the water pressure in the bathroom shower is very weak today.

​There is a minor water leak under the kitchen sink; could you send a plumber to fix it?

​The main circuit breaker keeps tripping whenever I turn on the air conditioner and water heater together.

​Could you please send an electrician to check the wall socket and wiring in the living room?

​When is the monthly rent payment due, and can I pay via online bank transfer?

​Does the apartment come fully furnished with a refrigerator, washing machine, and air conditioning?

​Can I extend my lease contract for another six months under the same rental rate?

​Could you please provide the latest official electricity and water meter numbers before I move in?

​2. Landlord, Utility Technician & Property Manager

​Good morning! Welcome to the apartment building; let me show you around the rental unit.

​The monthly rent is five million VND, payable on the first day of every month.

​A one-month security deposit is required upon signing the lease agreement.

​Electricity is billed at four thousand VND per kilowatt-hour based on your sub-meter reading.

​Water supply is charged at fifteen thousand VND per cubic meter according to your monthly usage.

​We conduct regular maintenance on the building's water pumps and electrical control panels.

​Please make sure to turn off all high-power electrical appliances when you leave the apartment.

​I will send our maintenance technician to inspect and fix the plumbing leak this afternoon.

​Our electrician will check the main distribution board to resolve the circuit breaker issue.

​The internet fiber-optic Wi-Fi cost and trash collection fee are already included in the rent.

​Here are two sets of keys and the electronic access card for the front gate.

​Please inspect all furniture and home appliances and sign the inventory checklist.

​The lease agreement is valid for one year, with a thirty-day notice period required for moving out.

​You can check your real-time electricity and water consumption on the utility sub-meters outside your door.

​Here is your monthly utility invoice; please review the meter numbers and total amount.

​3. Dialogues

​DIALOGUE 1: DISCUSSING RENT, LEASE TERMS & UTILITY RATES

​Tenant: "Good afternoon! I really like the layout of this one-bedroom apartment. What are the lease terms?"

​Landlord: "Good afternoon! I'm glad you like it. The monthly rent is six million VND, with a one-year lease contract and a one-month security deposit."

​Tenant: "Does the monthly rent include electricity, water, or internet?"

​Landlord: "High-speed Wi-Fi and trash collection are included. Electricity and clean water are billed separately based on your actual monthly usage."

​Tenant: "How are the electricity and water rates calculated?"

​Landlord: "There is an individual sub-meter right outside your apartment door. Electricity is 3,500 VND per unit, and water is 18,000 VND per cubic meter."

​Tenant: "That sounds very reasonable. Are there any extra fees for motorbike parking or building management?"

​Landlord: "No, motorbike parking in the basement is completely free for tenants. If everything looks good, we can sign the agreement today!"

​DIALOGUE 2: REPORTING AN ELECTRICAL AND PLUMBING ISSUE

​Tenant: "Hello, landlord! I am calling from apartment 302. I noticed two maintenance issues today."

​Property Manager: "Hello! What seems to be the problem in your unit?"

​Tenant: "First, the water tap under the bathroom sink is dripping continuously. Second, the bedroom power socket is not working."

​Property Manager: "I see. Did the circuit breaker trip for that outlet, or is it completely dead?"

​Tenant: "I checked the electrical panel; all breakers are on, so it might be a loose wire behind the socket wall."

​Property Manager: "Understood. Our maintenance technician will visit your apartment today at two PM to repair both the dripping tap and the electrical socket."

​Tenant: "That would be wonderful. Thank you so much for your prompt help!"

data.title: Bài 134: Các cuộc trao đổi - Quy trình tại Cơ quan Di trú (Gia hạn thị thực Visa)
data.transcript:
Conversations - Immigration Office Practices (Visa Extension)

​1. For Applicant

​Good morning! I am here to submit my application for a visa extension.

​Could you please give me the application form for extending my residence permit?

​Which counter should I go to for document submission and biometric verification?

​Here is my passport, current visa, filled application form, and passport-sized photos.

​I have brought my employment contract, tax statements, and proof of residence.

​How long does the visa extension processing usually take from the date of submission?

​Is there an expedited or fast-track processing service available for urgent travel?

​How much is the total application fee, and can I pay by credit card or cash?

​Could you please provide a receipt and a official confirmation slip for my passport submission?

​Will I be allowed to stay in the country legally while my visa extension is pending?

​Do I need to schedule an appointment to pick up my passport and new visa stamp?

​Can I track my visa application status online using this reference tracking number?

​Excuse me, do I need to register my updated home address with the local police department?

​What supporting documents are required if I am applying for a family stay visa extension?

​Could you please check if my application documents are complete and correctly filled out?

​2. Immigration Officer & Staff

​Good morning! Please take a queue number and wait for your turn in the waiting area.

​Please hand over your original passport, current residence card, and application form.

​Have you registered your temporary residence address with the local municipality?

​Please place your right index finger on the biometric scanner for fingerprint capture.

​Please look directly into the camera lens in front of you for your facial photo.

​We need additional supporting documents, including your latest bank bank statement and salary slip.

​Your current visa expires next week; please make sure all fees are paid today.

​The official visa extension processing time is ten to fourteen working days.

​Here is your payment receipt and application tracking slip; please keep it safe.

​You can use this stamped official acknowledgment letter as temporary proof of legal stay.

​We will notify you via SMS or email once your passport and visa extension are ready for pickup.

​Please check all details on your new visa sticker, including name spelling and expiry date, upon collection.

​Please note that late applications filed after your visa expiration date are subject to fines.

​Counter number four handles collection and passport returns between two and four PM.

​Thank you for your cooperation. Have a pleasant day!

​3. Dialogues

​DIALOGUE 1: SUBMITTING VISA EXTENSION DOCUMENTS & BIOMETRICS

​Officer: "Good morning! Next number, please. How can I help you today?"

​Applicant: "Good morning! I would like to submit my application to extend my work visa."

​Officer: "Sure. May I please have your original passport, current visa, completed form, and photos?"

​Applicant: "Here you go. I have also attached my employment contract, tax clearance, and housing lease agreement."

​Officer: "Thank you. Let me check your application documents... Everything looks complete. Now, please look directly at the camera for a photo."

​Applicant: "Sure, looking right at the camera."

​Officer: "Great. Now please place your right thumb on the biometric scanner to record your fingerprint."

​Applicant: "Done. How long will the visa extension approval take?"

​Officer: "It takes about ten working days. Please take this payment voucher to counter three to pay the application fee."

​Applicant: "Thank you! Can I stay legally in the country while waiting for my passport?"

​Officer: "Yes, the payment receipt and stamped copy of your application serve as official legal proof during processing."

​DIALOGUE 2: PICKING UP EXTENDED VISA & PASSPORT

​Applicant: "Good afternoon! I received an notification that my extended visa is ready for collection."

​Officer: "Good afternoon! Please show me your identification card and the original collection tracking slip."

​Applicant: "Here is my tracking slip and my digital national ID card."

​Officer: "Thank you. Please wait one moment while I retrieve your passport from the vault... Here is your passport."

​Applicant: "Thank you! Could you please help me confirm the details on the new visa sticker?"

​Officer: "Certainly. Your visa has been extended for another twelve months, valid until October twentieth next year."

​Applicant: "Wonderful! Do I need to report this new visa to the local police station for address registration?"

​Officer: "Yes, please update your residence status with your local neighborhood police within seven days of picking this up."

​Applicant: "Understood. Thank you very much for your guidance and support!"

data.title: Bài 60: Ngữ điệu lên-xuống và xuống-lên (Fall-Rise and Rise-Fall)
data.transcript:
1. Quy tắc: Fall-Rise (xuống rồi lên) thể hiện ngập ngừng, chưa chắc chắn, lịch sự, đối lập. Rise-Fall (lên rồi xuống) thể hiện nhấn mạnh, nhiệt tình, chắc chắn.
2. Ví dụ:
- I think it's ↘good↗... but... (Fall-Rise: ngập ngừng, chưa chắc tốt lắm)
- I ↘LOVE↗ it? No, I like it. (Fall-Rise: đối lập)
- You are ↗WELCOME↘! (Rise-Fall: nhiệt tình, chào mừng)
- That's ↗WONDERFUL↘! (Tuyệt vời! nhiệt tình)
- Are you sure? Well, I think ↘so↗... (không chắc)
3. Câu thực hành: I think your tea is wonderful, but maybe a little strong... You are welcome! That's wonderful!
4. Lưu ý: Ngữ điệu quyết định thái độ, quan trọng hơn cả từ vựng. Luyện tập với video mẫu.

data.title: Bài 61: Minimal Pairs /iː/ vs /ɪ/ (sheep/ship, feel/fill)
data.transcript:
Cặp âm dễ nhầm: i and ɪ.
1. Hướng dẫn khẩu hình: Âm i dài /iː/ cần kéo dài hơi và căng mép sang hai bên như đang cười. Âm i ngắn /ɪ/ phát âm thả lỏng cơ miệng, ngắn gọn và hơi giống âm ê trong tiếng Việt.
2. Từ vựng ví dụ:
Sheep /ʃiːp/ (con cừu) - Ship /ʃɪp/ (con tàu)
Feel /fiːl/ (cảm thấy) - Fill /fɪl/ (làm đầy)
Seat /siːt/ (chỗ ngồi) - Sit /sɪt/ (ngồi xuống)
Bean /biːn/ (hạt đỗ) - Bin /bɪn/ (thùng rác)
Leave /liːv/ (rời đi) - Live /lɪv/ (sống).
3. Câu thực hành: Sit in this seat and fill the ship with sheep.
4. Lưu ý: Luyện tập nghe phân biệt từng cặp từ, ghi âm lại giọng đọc và so sánh với mẫu để làm chủ sự khác biệt giữa âm dài căng và âm ngắn thả lỏng.

data.title: Bài 135: Conversations - Train & Metro Ticket Booking Practices
data.transcript:
Conversations - Train & Metro Ticket Booking Practices

​1. For Passenger & Traveler

​Good morning! I would like to buy a train ticket to downtown, please.

​Is this the correct counter to purchase single-trip tickets and daily transit passes?

​Could you please tell me how much a one-way ticket and a round-trip ticket cost?

​I would like to buy a one-day unlimited travel pass for the metro network.

​Is there a discount on train fares for students, senior citizens, or children?

​Which train line or metro station transfer do I need to take to reach the international airport?

​What time is the next express train leaving, and which platform does it depart from?

​Could I get a window seat facing forward in the non-smoking carriage, please?

​Do I need to tap my contactless travel card or scan the QR code at the automatic fare gates?

​Can I reload or top up my transit card balance using cash or a credit card at this ticket machine?

​Is there a dedicated luggage rack area inside the carriage for large suitcases?

​What should I do if I accidentally lose my ticket or tap out at the wrong station?

​Are seat reservations mandatory for this high-speed intercity train route?

​Could you give me a printed train timetable and a transit network route map?

​Can I get a full refund or exchange my ticket for a later departure time?

​2. Station Clerk & Ticket Agent

​Good morning! Welcome to the central railway station. Where are you traveling to today?

​Would you like a standard class ticket, or would you prefer first class for extra legroom?

​The next express train leaves from platform number three in fifteen minutes.

​You can top up your transit card at any automatic ticket vending machine or right here at the counter.

​Please place your contactless card on the card reader to complete the fare payment.

​To get to the airport station, take line two and transfer to the express line at Central Station.

​Please tap your ticket or smart card against the green sensor at the turnstile gate when entering and exiting.

​Child fares apply to children under twelve years old with a valid identity document.

​Here is your ticket, platform receipt, and change. Please check your departure gate number.

​Please stand behind the yellow safety line on the platform while waiting for the approaching train.

​Eating, drinking, and smoking are strictly prohibited inside the carriages and station concourse.

​If you miss your train, your ticket can be exchanged at counter five for the next available departure.

​Keep your physical ticket or digital QR code handy, as inspectors will verify it during the journey.

​Our customer service center near exit B handles lost items, card balance refunds, and travel inquiries.

​Thank you for traveling with us! Have a pleasant and safe journey!

​3. Dialogues

​DIALOGUE 1: PURCHASING A METRO TICKET & ASKING FOR DIRECTIONS

​Passenger: "Good morning! I would like to buy two single-ride tickets to the City Museum station."

​Clerk: "Good morning! That will be three dollars per ticket, so six dollars in total. Would you like to pay with cash or card?"

​Passenger: "I will pay with my credit card, please. Here you go."

​Clerk: "Thank you. Please tap or insert your card here... Payment approved. Here are your two metro tokens."

​Passenger: "Thank you! Which platform should we go to, and do we need to transfer along the way?"

​Clerk: "Take line one toward the North Terminal on platform two. You don't need to transfer—it's a direct route and takes about four stops."

​Passenger: "Got it, line one on platform two. How do we pass through the turnstiles with these tokens?"

​Clerk: "Just tap the token against the sensor pad at the entry gate, and insert it into the slot at the exit gate when you arrive."

​DIALOGUE 2: BUYING INTERCITY HIGH-SPEED TRAIN TICKETS

​Passenger: "Hi, good afternoon! I need to book two return tickets to the capital city for this Friday."

​Agent: "Good afternoon! What time would you like to depart on Friday?"

​Passenger: "We prefer a morning train around nine o'clock. Are there any seats available on the high-speed line?"

​Agent: "Let me check... Yes, we have the 09:15 AM high-speed express train. We have available seats in both standard class and business class."

​Passenger: "What is the price difference between standard and business class?"

​Agent: "Standard class is forty dollars per ticket, while business class is sixty-five dollars and includes wider reclining seats and complimentary beverages."

​Passenger: "We'll go with two standard class return tickets, please. Could we get two seats together by the window?"

​Agent: "Certainly. Seats 12A and 12B in carriage number four are assigned to you. Your return trip is scheduled for Sunday evening at six PM."

​Passenger: "Perfect! Here is my payment card. Thank you for your help!"
